subject: Board packet orchestration and approval — Q2 OKR readout
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: investor/board packet — Q2 OKRs + asks

Team — starting the thread for the board packet build. Attached is my initial slide roster and a short ask list. Goal: lock narrative + top-line asks by EOD next Friday so we can send to Oakridge on Feb 13 for pre-read.

Quick asks (please add owners inline):
- Executive summary: finalize two bullets on revenue cadence and GTM funnel recovery (owner: Marissa)
- OKR gap sheet: highlight three spots where we will not meet Q2 targets and mitigation plan (owner: Neha)
- Customer highlights: pick two expansion wins + one quote (owner: Tessa)
- Risks: legal/compliance items flagged for board attention (owner: Neha)

I attached a rough deck (2028_Q2_Board_Draft_v1.pdf) and an OKR gap tracker. Please review slide-by-slide and add comments in Drive. I built a suggested "asks" slide — we need to consolidate into max 3 asks.

Thanks — I will run a dry-run on Feb 14 with exec team.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachment: 2028_Q2_Board_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf)
attachment: OKR-Gap-Register.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-06T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: investor/board packet — Q2 OKRs + asks

Aisha — skimmed the deck. High-level notes:
- Exec summary: pull one customer metric into the first bullet (ARR retention trend) — gives credibility.
- Slide 6 (GTM funnel): please replace the top-of-funnel chart with the new cohort view from last week (I've uploaded a PNG to the Drive link).
- Asks: I'm +1 on three asks but suggest we reorder to lead with the SLA/uptime ask (this matters to enterprise), then funding runway ask, then product prioritization for latency improvements.

I've added comments on slides 3, 6, and 10. Also added a suggested two-line quote for the customer highlight (from CloudBase).

I'll own the executive summary bullets and the ask language. If legal needs softer wording for SLA ask, flag it.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Programs
attachment: GTM-funnel-cohort-202802.png (png)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-07T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: investor/board packet — Q2 OKRs + asks

Team — reviewed the OKR gap register. Short summary:
- OKR 2.1 (Throughput savings target): at risk ~20% shortfall due to longer latency on quantized models; mitigation: two-week optimization sprint + temporary routing policy (owner: Engineering, Marcus Lin).
- OKR 3.3 (Enterprise seat growth): delayed by procurement for two mid-market deals; mitigation: sales ops push + legal template update (owner: Marissa).
- OKR 4.2 (Support SLAs): warning flag — we have two incidents in Jan that need a short timeline and root-cause writeup for the board appendix.

Legal/Compliance notes: do not promise a specific SLA without counsel sign-off. I'll coordinate language with Legal and provide a short appendix (SLO-Uptime-Appendix.pdf) that gives current SLOs and remediation plan.

I added inline comments to the Gap register and suggested a one-slide risk heatmap for the packet.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Governance & Risk
attachment: SLO-Uptime-Appendix.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-09T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: investor/board packet — Q2 OKRs + asks

Thanks — I consolidated the asks and put a recommended owner column so the board can see clear owners and timing. Key changes:
- Asks (one slide):
  1) SLA commitment: request support for prioritizing SLA-hardening work and brief consent to runway for SRE hires (owner: Neha + Engineering)
  2) Ops runway: ask for flexibility on spend vs. hiring to cover burst GPU needs (owner: Finance)
  3) Product prioritization: approval for a small product fund for latency/quantization work (owner: Product/Engineering)

Added "Board narrative" bullet points:
- Progress vs. plan (what we hit, what we missed)
- Why misses matter and the mitigation timeline
- Where we need board input/decision (three asks only)

Pushed a refreshed two-slide appendix: 1) incident summary (two incidents) 2) SLO restoration plan. Attached the updated deck (v2) with comments.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP, Customer Success
attachment: 2028_Q2_Board_Draft_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Susan Lambert <susan.lambert@oakridgevc.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Secretariat <board@oakridgevc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-10T10:22:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Board packet orchestration and approval — Q2 OKR readout

Aisha — thanks for the early sight. Two quick asks from the board's side:
1) Please include a one-slide appendix summarizing incident impact on customers (duration, affected customers, mitigation) — the board needs to see transparency.
2) Could you add a short note on how the SLA ask maps to hiring (FTE vs contractor) and expected incremental monthly run-rate? Ex: $X/month for SRE contractor bench vs. $Y for full hire.

We expect pre-reads by Feb 13. If you need a quick sync with the board chair, happy to set 30 mins on Feb 15.

— Susan Lambert
Board Member, Oakridge Ventures

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-12T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Board packet — approval request (final review by EOD)

Team — forwarding Susan's note. Need final confirmations by EOD today so I can send pre-read to Oakridge tomorrow morning. Concrete next steps:
- Marissa: finalize exec summary bullets and confirm the customer quote (CloudBase) — reply with exact two lines.
- Neha: finalize the SLO appendix and add the incident impact slide (I'll pull language from your draft).
- Tessa: lock the asks slide and populate the owner + expected monthly runway cost for the SRE ask (estimate + source).

If I don't hear back by 17:00 PT I'll escalate to the exec chain for sign-off. Dry-run on Feb 14 at 9:00 PT.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
